Quick note — small ops reminder: label times with TZ abbreviations and include UTC in the invite. Last time we had Sydney attendees see "Friday" because their calendar defaulted to AEDT after DST change; while DST doesn't start in NSW until October, some corporate calendars showed future DST rules and that produced a day-shift. Also include explicit ISO times in the invite title (e.g., "2026-09-23 15:00 SGT / 07:00 UTC") to avoid the next-day confusion.
